notes: Smarter date month inference on long studies, plus multi-week study support (14/21/28 day studies process as automatic weekly report passes).

changes: Fixed a wrong-month date inference bug on long studies. When the end date sat about as many days after the set date as the same day number sat before it (a 15-day gap tie), the app could read e.g. 'Wed 22' as Jun 22 instead of Jul 22 and click the date 23 days in the wrong direction. Date inference now uses the weekday name shown next to the day number to pin down the month, floors end dates at the set date (no data can exist before the tubes went in), and breaks any remaining tie toward the later date.

Multi-week study support: Study Length now accepts 14, 21, and 28 days. Studies longer than 7 days are automatically processed as weekly report passes in a single run (e.g. a 14-day study set 7/7 processes Jul 08 to Jul 15, then Jul 15 to Jul 22), each pass loading the same EC0 file(s) and adjusting the time range to its own week.

Weekly passes run in rounds: week 1 for every site first, then MTExec restarts and week 2 runs for every site, and so on. MTExec crashes if the same EC0 file is loaded twice in one session, so each round gets a fresh instance.
The MTExec restart sequence (used for error recovery, the 25-site limit, the individual-report phase, and now week rounds) was five copy-pasted blocks; it is now one shared routine.
Weekly pass reports save with a week suffix on the processing name (e.g. '1_Main St NB Wk1', '... Wk2'), and the tracker sheet status only flips to READY TO PROCESS after the final week's pass saves.

Weekly passes force Manual date processing even if an aligned-days option is selected globally, since those shortcuts would ignore the per-week date ranges and produce identical reports for every week.
Odd lengths split cleanly too: a 10-day study runs as a 7-day pass plus a 3-day pass.

Fixed date adjustment arrow detection during manual time range processing. The search zone was looking in the wrong spot relative to the date box, so the app paused on every site while the image search timed out before falling back. The zone is now anchored to the day arrows' actual position, the match is instant, and the per-site pause is gone.

Added per-machine image template support: the app now auto-prefers <name>_pc.png captures on ultrawide / high-res monitors and keeps preferring _Helix variants on Helix laptops. Applied to the left/right date arrows and the report profile labels.

Custom reports profile selection now image-matches the profile row (ALL STATS / SPEED STATS) inside a zone around the expected row and picks the nearest match, so rows sharing a label prefix can't be confused. The known-good fixed coordinate is kept as a fallback.
Activity Log text can now be highlighted and copied with the mouse, and a new Copy button copies the entire log to the clipboard in one click.
Image-rec diagnostics: when an arrow match fails, the app now saves a debug screenshot to logs/ and records the best correlation score, so template mismatches can be diagnosed instead of guessed at.
Complete UI overhaul: switched from Tkinter to a modern HTML interface running in pywebview. Cleaner look, better proportions, more responsive on every machine.

Site Parameters table rebuilt with fixed pixel widths so headers and cells stay aligned regardless of DPI or screen size. Added a column-hover glow effect and refined inline editors for dates, checkboxes, and dropdowns.
Added Recents dropdowns next to the Project Tracker URL and Project Folder fields. Trackers show the actual sheet name, not just the URL. Persists across launches.
New 'Get Started' stepper at the top walks through Load Tracker -> Load Folder -> Set Study Length -> Scan Files. Auto-hides once everything is set up.
Reworked the during-processing error prompt: 10-second countdown with Stop / Retry / Skip to Next buttons. Pops to the front of MTExec so it's actually visible. Auto-skips on timeout.
Site processing loops now support retry. Picking Retry reattempts the same site up to 3 times before moving on.
Cross-machine cursor reliability: mouse moves now verify their position via Win32 before clicking. Fixes the 'click fires before mouse arrives' issue on slower laptops.
Image recognition got a multi-scale fallback: if the standard match fails, it retries the template at 0.875x through 1.125x to handle DPI / font-scaling differences across machines.
Fixed the Date Processing dropdown so it actually populates the right options when you change study length.

Security hardening: credentials are encrypted on disk via Windows DPAPI after first launch (plaintext is wiped). All Python dependencies pinned to exact versions. External CDN references for fonts and icons removed (everything ships locally now). Input validation added across the JS-to-Python bridge.

Build hardening: only known file types get bundled (no stray dev files in releases), the .exe carries proper version metadata, UPX compression disabled (was triggering AV false positives), and the build script validates the version string before using it in shell.
Bundle trimming: dropped 85MB of unused Google API discovery JSONs, switched to opencv-python-headless, slimmed the bundled creature images.

Fixed an issue involving date adjustment when processing data on manual date processing. The # of days to adjust was sometimes_not calculating correctly when the data spanned multiple months. It should now always calculate the correct # of days to adjust.

Refined CA EC0 filename parsing: if the first token is 3–5 letters and not 'BOX', use it as the box id (e.g., 'BRIG', 'GULF', 'NOVA'); if the name starts with 'BOX', use the next token; also recognizes embedded 'BOX <alnum> 0' anywhere in the name.
Dual-candidate matching: tries both the 3–5 letter code and the numeric/D-series token after 'BOX' (e.g., 'BRIG' and '56') so California projects match reliably regardless of tracker convention.

UI: Added 'Reset (Clear All)' button in the Action Buttons row (after Stop, before Help) to reinitialize the app—clears loaded tracker & project folder, wipes Site Parameters, resets internal flags, and empties Status.
Minor UI fixes: made it so entries on the site parameters frame will better stay aligned with their headers.

Stability polish: safer stop/cleanup of worker state on reset; clears pause/stop events; extra guards for missing/cleared widgets; scrollregion refresh for Site Parameters after table clears; slightly clearer status messages during reset.
Updated file matching logic: Now intelligently handles California's 4-letter box names (TYPE, TOMB, PLAN, GOWN, etc.) and inconsistent naming formats.
Enhanced box extraction: If filename starts with 'BOX', takes the word after it; otherwise takes the first word. Handles all state formats seamlessly.
Expanded EC0 folder detection: Now searches for 'ec0', 'ECO', 'EC0 Files', 'ECO Files' and all case variations, making setup more flexible.
Responsive UI improvements: Added vertical resizing for Status and Site Parameters sections, scrollable main controls, and better small-screen support.
